title: RTP Menu
description: RTP supporting Multiverse, Towny, GriefPrevention and customization with ItemsAdder, soon more!
body:
RTP Menu allows you to teleport randomly to any world you want, within borders you define, respecting a blacklist of blocks you don't want your players to teleport on top of. If your server also runs Towny or GriefPrevention, you can set whether you want to allow, or deny teleportations to coordinates protected by either of these plugins! RTP Menu also allows you to customize the menu by allowing you to use ItemsAdder to change its texture, and the buttons' (items) with IA items! This plugin supports both English and French by default, but if your players don't speak either of those, worry not! You can create your own localization files and translate every piece of text in the plugin for your players. This also allows you to customize what the plugin says in order to fit a certain theme! ![The RTP menu. The title says RTP Menu in dark green. There are three items which serve as buttons to pick which world to teleport to: a grass block for the Overworld, a netherrack block for the Nether and an end stone block for the End.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f4abcd5f3235bc4483876e9de1c6e27cc9ceb6d1.png) Support for more plugins will come in the coming updates!
If you have suggestions for plugins to support, or new features, don't hesitate and join my Discord server!
